timer.title: Teaching Timer
timer.description: Use a timed challenge before students share ideas.
timer.prompt: When the timer ends, students can raise their hand and explain their idea.
timer.times-up: Time is up. Invite answers from the class.

teaching-tools.title: Teaching Tools
teaching-tools.description: Use quick mouse actions for highlights, arrows, and diagonals while teaching.
teaching-tools.action-rectangle: Shift or Cmd/Ctrl + right drag rectangle
teaching-tools.action-piece-control: Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + right click square control
teaching-tools.help-right-click: Right click any square to highlight only that square. Click any square normally to clear the teaching marks.
teaching-tools.help-multi-squares: Hold Shift, then right click more squares to add or remove them one by one.
teaching-tools.help-piece-legal: Hold Command on Mac or Ctrl on Windows/Linux, then right click a side-to-move piece to highlight its legal moves from the current position.
teaching-tools.help-arrow: Right drag from one square to another to draw or remove an arrow.
teaching-tools.help-rectangle: Hold Shift, or hold Command on Mac or Ctrl on Windows/Linux, while right dragging from one corner to another to highlight the whole rectangle area.
teaching-tools.help-piece-captures: Hold Command on Mac or Ctrl on Windows/Linux, plus Shift, then right click a side-to-move piece to highlight only its capture squares.
teaching-tools.help-piece-control: Hold Command on Mac or Ctrl on Windows/Linux, plus Shift, then right click any empty square or non-active piece to highlight which white and black pieces control that square.
teaching-tools.help-piece-checks: Hold Alt, then right click a side-to-move piece to highlight only the legal moves that give check.
teaching-tools.help-clear: Press C or Esc to clear all highlights and arrows.
